about.title: About me
about.description1: Hi, I'm Sarah and I live in the Dolomites! I am a dynamic and curious person and this has led me to explore many things, in the end I decided that Yoga was my path. I firmly believe that in this society people need to reconnect with themselves, with nature and with their breath.
about.description2: I started practicing Yoga in 2016 and I immediately fell in love with it. It was a period of overthinking and during the hours of Yoga I managed not to think for a whole hour, almost like magic.
about.description3: After raving to anyone about its benefits (I still do), I decided to undertake teacher training in Milan. I trained with the Samadhi school, which founded Anukalana Yoga.
about.extended_description1: I teach yoga in Cortina d'Ampezzo, Belluno, Ponte nelle Alpi, and throughout the Cadore region (Tai di Cadore, Vodo di Cadore, Calalzo). I offer group classes in studios and personalized private sessions, both in-person and online.
about.extended_description2: I am certified in Anukalana Yoga (Samadhi School Milan) and also specialized in Yin Yoga, Kids Yoga, and Pilates. My mission is to help people rediscover balance, wellbeing, and connection with themselves through the practice of yoga.
about.extended_description3: During summer I organize outdoor yoga sessions in stunning Dolomites locations, including BAR ALPINO in Calalzo di Cadore, Malga Caseera Razzo in Vigo, and after mountain hikes at various rifugi. I'm also available for private events and yoga retreats.
about.credential1: Anukalana Yoga teacher training — Samadhi School, Milan
about.approach1: No competition and no fixed shape to reach: every sequence is offered with variations, so the practice adapts to the body that showed up today.
about.approach2: Breath first. Movement follows it, never the other way round — that is what turns an hour of exercise into an hour of quiet.
about.approach3: Small groups, so I can actually see you, adjust an alignment, and remember what you are working on.

classes.title: What I teach
classes.intro: Five ways into the practice — from fluid Anukalana to long Yin holds — in studio between Belluno and Cadore, outdoors in the Dolomites, or one to one.

anukalana.title: Anukalana Yoga
anukalana.description_long: Anukalana means integration, in fact it is a style that combines many notions: obviously Asana, Pranayama, Meditations, but also myofascia, meridians and energy centers. It bases movements on fluidity, coordination with the breath and gentleness. What fascinated me most about this style is that it is suitable for everyone. It is not competitive, but truly aimed at the well-being of each individual.
anukalana.description: Integrated practice combining asana, pranayama, meditation and fascia work. Gentle, breath-led sequences focused on fluidity and overall wellbeing.
anukalana.expect1: A gentle warm-up that syncs movement to the rhythm of the breath.
anukalana.expect2: Fluid asana sequences built around myofascial lines and energy centres.
anukalana.expect3: Pranayama to settle the nervous system before stillness.
anukalana.expect4: A closing meditation and a long, unhurried savasana.
anukalana.info1: Open to every level — sequences are offered with variations, never as a competition.
anukalana.info2: Around 60 to 75 minutes, in studio between Belluno, Ponte nelle Alpi and Cadore.
anukalana.info3: Bring a mat and comfortable clothes; blocks, straps and bolsters are provided.

yin.title: Yin Yoga
yin.description_long: Yin yoga is a slow-paced style of yoga in which poses are held for longer periods of time than in more active styles. We will get comfortable with cushions called 'bolsters', yoga blocks, and whatever else is needed to make the asanas comfortable and perfectly suited to everyone's needs and flexibility. The purpose of yin yoga is to stimulate the connective tissue, applying optimal tension for a certain time and maintaining deep breathing. By doing this, the connective tissue lengthens, strengthens, and slowly opens up, creating more space between the joints, improving their movement and making them more solid, stable, and strong, and increasing muscle flexibility.
yin.description: Slow passive postures held with props. Stimulates connective tissue, opens the joints and invites deep breathing and restorative release.
yin.expect1: Three to five minutes in each shape, supported by bolsters, blocks and blankets.
yin.expect2: Slow, deep breathing that lets connective tissue release instead of being forced.
yin.expect3: Targeted work on hips, spine and shoulders, where tension collects.
yin.expect4: A guided relaxation to close, so the body absorbs the practice.
yin.info1: Especially useful if you train hard, sit all day, or sleep badly.
yin.info2: Around 60 minutes — the pace never rises, so it pairs well with a dynamic practice.
yin.info3: Wear layers: the body cools down when it stays still.

kids.title: Kid's Yoga
kids.description_long: Getting children involved in Yoga is very important nowadays. The Bimbiyoga method has a playful and fun approach to capture children's attention. We will explore the Asanas through stories, songs, and games. There will also be moments of listening, awareness, and small meditations.
kids.description: Playful sessions built on stories, songs and games to explore asanas, breath awareness and mindful listening — building confidence and calm.
kids.expect1: Asanas discovered through stories, songs and games, following the Bimbiyoga method.
kids.expect2: Breathing exercises turned into play, to name and handle big emotions.
kids.expect3: Moments of listening and short meditations, sized for short attention spans.
kids.expect4: Group games that build confidence, coordination and respect for others.
kids.info1: Designed for children roughly 4 to 11 years old, in small groups.
kids.info2: 45 to 60 minutes, in Vodo di Cadore and on request for schools and associations.
kids.info3: Only a mat and comfortable clothes are needed — no experience required.

locations.title: Where I Teach
locations.subtitle: Yoga classes in Cortina, Belluno and throughout Cadore

belluno.title: Yoga in Belluno
belluno.subtitle: Anukalana, Vinyasa and Yin Yoga classes
belluno.description: I regularly teach in Belluno with several weekly classes of Anukalana, Vinyasa, and Yin Yoga. Classes are held in welcoming studios and are suitable for all levels, from beginners to advanced students.
belluno.description2: Belluno is where most of my week happens: a dynamic morning practice to open the day, slower breath-led sequences in the evening, and Yin for anyone who needs to slow down rather than push. Groups stay small on purpose, so nobody practises unseen.
belluno.venue1: Belluno — Anukalana, Vinyasa and Yin Yoga in a welcoming studio, all levels welcome.
belluno.venue2: Ponte nelle Alpi — Anukalana classes a few minutes from the centre of Belluno.
belluno.venue3: At your place or your office — private and small-group sessions across the province.
belluno.venue4: Online — the same practice over video, wherever you happen to be.

cortina.title: Yoga in Cortina d'Ampezzo and Cadore
cortina.subtitle: Studio and outdoor classes in the Dolomites
cortina.description: In Cortina d'Ampezzo and the Cadore region (Vodo di Cadore, Tai di Cadore, Calalzo) I offer weekly Anukalana Yoga classes and special outdoor sessions during summer. Also available for private events and yoga retreats in stunning Dolomites locations.
cortina.description2: The valley sets the rhythm here: indoors through the winter, outside as soon as the pastures open. If you are visiting the Dolomites you are welcome to drop into a class — no membership, no long-term commitment, just let me know you are coming.
cortina.venue1: Cortina d'Ampezzo — studio classes, plus sessions for guests, hotels and private groups.
cortina.venue2: Vodo di Cadore — Anukalana for adults and Kid's Yoga for the little ones.
cortina.venue3: Tai di Cadore — Anukalana Yoga, open to every level.
cortina.venue4: Calalzo di Cadore — outdoor practice at BAR ALPINO through the summer.

outdoor.title: Outdoor Yoga
outdoor.subtitle: Summer sessions in the open air in the Dolomites
outdoor.hero_subtitle: Practice yoga outdoors in the mountains
outdoor.description1: During summer months I organize outdoor yoga sessions in some of the most stunning locations in the Dolomites. Practicing yoga immersed in nature amplifies the benefits of the practice, fostering a deep connection with the surrounding environment.
outdoor.description2: Outdoor sessions are open to all levels and include Anukalana, Vinyasa practices, and guided meditations. A unique experience to rejuvenate body and mind.
outdoor.location1_desc: Morning sessions with Dolomites views in a welcoming and panoramic location.
outdoor.location2_desc: High-altitude yoga surrounded by alpine pastures, an experience of total connection with nature.
outdoor.location3_desc: Special events at mountain huts and after hikes in the Cortina, Belluno, and Cadore areas.
outdoor.practical1: A mat, or a towel if you are travelling light — I carry a few spares.
outdoor.practical2: Layers: mornings in the mountains are colder than down in the valley, even in August.
outdoor.practical3: Water, sunscreen, and shoes you can walk the last stretch in.

private.title: Private Lessons
private.subtitle: Personalized sessions online and in-person
private.description1: I offer personalized private yoga lessons both in-person (Cortina, Belluno, Cadore) and online. Each session is designed around your specific needs, whether you're a beginner or advanced practitioner.
private.description2: Private lessons are ideal for those who want individual attention, have specific goals (flexibility, strength, relaxation), or prefer to practice in a private setting.
private.description3: We usually start with a short conversation about what you want from the practice and anything your body is dealing with — an old injury, a stiff back, a stressful stretch at work. From there I build a sequence around you, and we adjust it as you go.
private.benefit2: Flexible scheduling to fit your commitments
private.benefit3: Individual attention on posture and alignment
private.benefit5: Available online from wherever you are

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how SMUP Yoga ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.
privacy.section1_content: When you contact us through our website, we collect the following information: your name, email address, and any message you choose to send us. This information is provided voluntarily by you when you fill out our contact form.
privacy.section2_content: We use the information you provide solely to respond to your inquiries, schedule yoga classes, and communicate with you about our services. We will never sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section3_content: Your contact form submissions are processed through EmailJS, a third-party email service. We retain your information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy. We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.section4_content: Under GDPR and Italian privacy law, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also object to or restrict certain processing of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact us at smup.yoga@gmail.com.
privacy.section5_content: Our website uses EmailJS to process contact form submissions. EmailJS has its own privacy policy governing the use of your information. We do not use cookies or tracking technologies on this website.
privacy.section6_content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
